issues: Duplicates live BX266 (known heart failure, dullness to percussion and reduced breath sounds at both bases -> pleural effusions): same sign pattern and same learning point (dull + reduced breath sounds = effusion); only the aetiology and laterality differ, so this is a diagnosis-only re-skin.
